name: Pomerado
description: Builds MCP tools for websites, including sites without an API, from a plain-language task, so agents can search, fill forms and book on real sites.

skills.name: Find Website Tool
skills.description: Searches Pomerado's catalog for a ready-made tool that does a task on a website, by task, by site or both.

skills.name: Run Website Tool
skills.description: Runs a website tool once with its input and returns a validated result through a job you can follow, answer or cancel.

skills.name: Build Website Tool
skills.description: Builds a new read or write tool for a website from a plain-language task when no existing tool covers it.

skills.name: Saved Logins and 2FA
skills.description: Signs in to websites with saved logins and finishes two-step sign-in with an authenticator key, recovery codes or a phone number.

skills.name: Job Webhooks
skills.description: Sends a signed request to your server when a job asks a question or finishes, for backends calling the REST API.
